title: Robust Spectral Recovery for Dynamical Sampling
summary: We study the spectral recovery problem for dynamical sampling on a finite cyclic grid. Given time snapshots obtained from a fixed uniform spatial subsampling of the orbit $x_{\ell}=A^{\ell}f$, we aim to recover the spectrum of the unknown circular convolution operator $A$. However, in the presence of outliers, even in only a few snapshots, existing approaches often struggle to recover the spectrum.
